application PolicyExample
a User has a required unique email as text
a Task has a required title as text
each Task belongs to a User as owner on delete restrict
authentication uses User identified by email
role Contributor
role Manager extends Contributor
action complete a Task
  require title is not "done" otherwise "Already done"
  set title to "done"
policy OwnedTasks
  allow to read Task
  allow to create and update own Task
  allow to run all actions on own Task
grant OwnedTasks to Contributor
